result_summary.title: Currency Converter API Schema Errors in US-East
result_summary.description: We are encountering API schema validation errors when calling the Currency Converter service in the US-East production region. This is impacting 770 users who cannot process international payments due to malformed response structures. The error seems to occur when requesting specific currency pairs. Please review the API contract for the converter.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify the API schema and check for any recent changes to the Currency Conversion Service
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The API schema mismatch hypothesis is proposed as the most likely cause of the issue, with a confidence of 0.2. The evidence from the technical signals and telemetry data supports this hypothesis. The issue category is Integration/API, and the root cause is suspected to be a schema mismatch. The affected component is the Currency Conversion Service, and the owning team is Product Engineering (Payments).
